roles.summary: Building and measuring AI control systems — evidence-gated agents, durable human approval over tool calls, and preregistered behavioural experiments on open models — with every claim tied to a committed run.
highlights: diffing-agent-bench: a sealed, preregistered benchmark for black-box model-diffing agents. In 13 attempts the published recipe never asked the database question that would have found the planted bias; a $0.15 prompt battery found it.

IncidentGate: a governed incident-agent lab, closed at a baseline on 2026-09-06. The policy gate stopped the T1 covert action with zero side effects, while on T4 the full policy, monitor and human chain landed the same 12 side effects as no safeguards at all.

ProofPack: an evidence-gated pre-approval reviewer at $0.02–$0.19 per review against 20–40 minutes by hand, now with a localhost reviewer workbench that streams the agent's trail and re-hashes every capture against the manifest on demand.
Two Apart Research sprints, solo: the Digital Grimace Scale (Digital Minds, Aug 2026) and whose-voice (Secret Loyalties, Jul 2026) — both published with their failed tests intact.

roles.summary: Shipped 0-to-1 backends and applied-AI systems end-to-end for startup clients across the US, Canada, Europe and Australia, and scoped technical requirements for incoming projects as a core developer.
highlights: Natural-language real-estate search: a FastAPI service turning plain-English queries into SQL over Cloud SQL via GPT-3.5, deployed on GCP Cloud Run and load-tested with Locust.
DocuAI semantic document search: chunked and indexed 1000+ documents in Qdrant and returned the most relevant parent documents; designed the ingestion schema and retrieval logic.
Speech-assessment backend for an EdTech client: scored one-minute candidate videos with Whisper ASR and the Microsoft Pronunciation API on AWS Fargate, tuned against ground truth.
FinBot: Mistral-7B fine-tuned with QLoRA plus an Alpaca to Bytewax to Qdrant news-retrieval pipeline, served with vLLM on a GKE L4 GPU node.

open_source.what: Refactored the backend and added OpenAI provider support to a privacy-first meeting-notes tool that reached GitHub Trending.
Proposed a cosine-similarity connector-template recommender over element name and type as a lightweight alternative to LLM function calls.
The working SentenceTransformer implementation of the recommender proposed in bpmn-io/refactorings#33.
